excerpts.content: Was there a plan to change anything on the nimbus side? We're prepping a besu release but think it might still be an issue for nimbus-nethermind combos, potentially erigon too

excerpts.author: siladu
excerpts.content:
Sorry, picking on nimbus again 😅 ...it appears you still send us engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV1 after the fork.

It's possible this could cause some minor bugs related to these spec changes https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/shanghai.md#specification-1
but importantly, it would block ELs from being able to delete the V1 methods.

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: We'd like to announce the deprecation of the Zhejiang testnet (https://zhejiang.ethpandaops.io/). It was meant for testing withdrawals, but now that Shapella is live we'd like to tear down the network. Unless someone reaches out with an argument to keep it up longer, the testnet will be shutdown on Wednesday (19th April).

excerpts.content: <@425572898787426305> I would like to drop the requirement to return executionpayloadv1 before shanghai

excerpts.content: You mean to deprecate it?

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Yes

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: And I would like to go to a system where versions are tied to specific hardforks

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: so, no changes between hardforks would be allowed?

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: So that it's not possible to call v3 before shanghai etc

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Well you could still backport the change to the last hardfork

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: But not this v2 can be called in merge and shanghai thing

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: The logic (at least for us) is extremely fragile and kinda hard to reason about and the place where most bugs occurred in shanghai

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: Oh, I see. So V2 is strictly for Shanghai, V3 is strictly for Cancun, etc

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden

excerpts.content: and V3 can potentially be extended to Prague if there are no changes to the Engine API?

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: If the change is backward compatible. All backward incompatible changes can wait for the next hardfork. Would you mind to file an issue with this proposal? Btw, I am curious what if we add a new field to the payload for instance, is this a change that can be backported?

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Yep we can backport that

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: Oh, actually `getPayloadV3` that still returns `ExecutionPayloadV2` but has some additional field in the response doesn't break this. You can't call this new method before Shanghai, but one will be able to call `getPayloadV2` and `getPayloadV3` before Cancun
